```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, fig.width = 6, fig.asp = .6)
```

```{r}
library(p8105.datasets)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(leaflet)
data(nyc_airbnb)
```

# Some questions
* where are the most expensive airbnbs in nyc?
* do description correlate with price?
* what about text reviews?


```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(neighbourhood_group =="Manhattan") |>
  count(room_type, neighbourhood) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = room_type,
    values_from = n
  )
```

# price
```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  group_by(neighbourhood_group) |>
  mutate(price_rank = min_rank(desc(price))) |>
  filter(price_rank < 3)
```

```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(price < 1000) |>
  ggplot(aes(x=price)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  facet_grid(room_type ~ neighbourhood_group)
```
## Host stuff
```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |>
  filter(price < 500) |>
  filter(room_type != "Shared room") |>
  mutate(neighbourhood = fct_reorder(neighbourhood, price)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = neighbourhood, y = price)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid(. ~ room_type) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
```
```{r}
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |>
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
  filter(price < 500) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lat , y = long, color = price)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .5)
```

make leaflet map
```{r}
pal = colorNumeric(
  palette = "viridis", 
  domain = 1:500
)
nyc_airbnb |>
  filter(neighbourhood_group == "Manhattan") |>
  filter(room_type == "Entire home/apt") |>
  filter(price < 500) |>
  # sample_n(50) |>
  leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |> # the map in the background
  addCircleMarkers(~lat, ~ long, color = ~pal(price), radius = .5)
```
